Enrolled patients were referred to the Pediatric Pulmonology and Respiratory Intermediate Care Unit of Bambino Gesù Children's Hospital (Rome, Italy) for a multidisciplinary follow-up program between 2000 and 2020. Our hospital is the reference point for the Italian pediatric population, especially from central and southern regions.
